audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real number (COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); dosFull/dontsFull rows were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad (COPY_PASTE_BLEED)
audit.why: Xerath's R is a self-immobilizing channel any hard CC cancels. Crescendo stuns on a long 140/120/100s cooldown, so eating it mid-ult is rare but costly and worth naming with the real number. Separately, Sona's Q scales with her attack speed via on-hit, so a pure-armor reading of the poke trade underrates her damage once she has attack-speed items.
